title: mathAgents G-AX statement-change record
description: reports/dossiers/<slug>/gax.json. Human G-AX decisions on changes to statements that already held a G-FID approval (spec DD-36, DD-37): an added hypothesis, a weakened statement, or any other change of an approved declaration's statement_fingerprint (which, under DD-34, also covers the project definitions it reaches). The dossier validator requires a record naming the old and new fingerprints before the changed statement may be approved again. Approvals are human decisions (DD-29); a waiver records an operator's in-session extension of the kernel-as-judge override to G-AX (D26, DD-30). Append-only: records are never removed or edited.

new_fingerprint.description: The new statement's fingerprint, or 'removed' when an approved declaration is dropped from the fidelity record.

toolchain_pin.description: The instance's lean/lean-toolchain when this was recorded (docs/lean-version-governance.md R6). Optional; the dossier validator warns when it differs from the current pin.

mathlib_rev.description: The Mathlib commit (lake-manifest.json rev) when this was recorded (R6). Optional; checked like toolchain_pin.
